# PharmNode
> Advanced B2B Decision Support System (DSS) virtual formulation studio for pharmaceutical design, powder flowability calculations, raw material compatibility verification, and GMP-compliant PDF export.

## Main Pages
- [/features](/features): Detailed overview of formulation editing, physics simulation, compatibility screens, and GMP export.
- [/workflow](/workflow): Step-by-step description of raw materials selection, mixing simulation, and press settings.
- [/about](/about): Our mission to replace physical laboratory iterations with deterministic scientific rules.
- [/use-cases](/use-cases): Real-world compounding challenges solved (flowability, capping, and chemical substitutions).
- [/technologies](/technologies): Underlying physics equations (Carr Index, Hausner Ratio, porosity) and tech stack.
- [/regulatory](/regulatory): Compliance specifications for FDA Title 21 CFR Part 11, FALCPA allergens, and eCTD module readiness.
- [/pricing](/pricing): License tier matrix (Hobby vs. Professional limits, standard vs. custom raw materials).

## Knowledge Base & Reference
- [/knowledge-base/compatibility-matrix](/knowledge-base/compatibility-matrix): Explains chemical compatibility rules and matrices across 35 distinct chemical classes.
- [/knowledge-base/excipients](/knowledge-base/excipients): Searchable directory of compounding raw materials, densities, and safe limits.
- [/api-reference](/api-reference): Technical documentation of the REST API, schemas, endpoints, and latency specs.

## Extended Resources
- [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt): Complete, raw text documentation and details of all platform pages for RAG systems.
